title: Concrete Strength Prediction
summary: Machine learning model predicting concrete compressive strength based on material composition parameters.
problem: Traditional 28-day concrete strength curing tests delay construction timelines and material quality validation.
solution: Trained regression algorithms on material component datasets (cement, blast furnace slag, fly ash, water, superplasticizer) for accurate instant strength prediction.
features: Data cleaning, feature scaling, and correlation matrix analysis across material inputs
Supervised regression modeling evaluating algorithm metrics (RMSE, R² score)
Interactive predictor interface for real-time mix evaluation
